title: OPERA Surface Disturbance Status (DIST-ALERT GEN-DIST-STATUS)
description:
Researchers working with the Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA) and Observational Products for End-Users from Remote Sensing Analysis (OPERA) teams at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pasadena, California, produce the OPERA Land Surface Disturbance Alert (DIST-ALERT) products. Each image is a mosaic of the GEN-DIST-STATUS layer, which reports the detection status and confidence of surface disturbance for each pixel relative to a pre-event baseline.
Results posted here are preliminary, primarily intended to aid field response, and are provided with absolutely no warranty of any kind. Use at your own risk.
GEN-DIST-STATUS classes:
0: No disturbance
1: First detection, low confidence
2: Provisional, low confidence
3: Confirmed, low confidence
4: First detection, high confidence
5: Provisional, high confidence
6: Confirmed, high confidence
'First' is a single anomalous observation with no follow-up yet; 'provisional' is two consecutive detections; 'confirmed' is a high-confidence detection.
